day.headline: A Ox day — Snake and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Snake and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a cold snap nobody dressed for
signs.message: Nobody saw this cold coming. Layer up, then head out.

reasons: Rooster and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Break the silence yourself. One line, nothing about why it happened.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the relative who calls at odd hours
signs.message: Answer when she calls at some ridiculous hour. Ten minutes, done.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Be there when they unlock. Whole place to yourself.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You nodded through half of that. Ask them to explain again.

reasons: Ox's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: The peaches are going. Eat them over the sink today.

reasons: Rat pairs with Ox — a harmonious day
signs.message: Pull the duvet straight before you leave. Changes the room.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: She'll pick the worst possible moment. Reply after, not during.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the reference number you cannot find
signs.message: Stop digging for that number. It keeps till tomorrow.

reasons: Goat opposes Ox — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the ticket stub in your wallet
signs.message: The stub from that night stays put. No wallet cleanout.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a person you keep almost calling
signs.message: Almost calling is still thinking about them. Leave it today.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a message arriving at the right moment
signs.message: That message landed right when it should. No reply needed tonight.
